detail.description: Continue ceftriaxone 2 g IV q24h for definitive therapy; maintain through hospital day 5 then reassess for IV-to-PO step-down based on culture-driven narrowing and clinical response.
Avoid piperacillin-tazobactam and amoxicillin given documented penicillin allergy (urticaria + periorbital angioedema 2018, high criticality).
Avoid ciprofloxacin given culture-confirmed resistance on the May 2026 mid-stream urine isolate.
Norepinephrine titration to MAP >= 65 mmHg if hypotension persists after 30 mL/kg crystalloid bolus.
Repeat lactate at hour 2 and trend creatinine q12h; escalate to ICU continuous monitoring.
Urology consult to evaluate the BPH-driven post-void residual that likely seeded the recurrent E. coli urosepsis.
